name: push-up-bosu-ball
title: Push-Up: Bosu Ball
primer: This is an exercise for chest, core, shoulders, and triceps strengthening with the use of a Bosu ball.
steps: Place the Bosu ball flat side down on the floor.
Get into a push-up position with your hands on the ball, your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Keeping your abs drawn in and your body straight, bend your elbows to lower your chest to the ball.
Pause for a moment and then return to the starting position.
tips: Ensure your elbows remain close to your body while lowering your chest to the ball.
Beginners may want to start on their knees with your feet off the ground so you are rocking into the Push Up.
